## Checklist

- [ ] The title is past tense, 60 characters or fewer (it becomes the squash commit)
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behaviour
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated, and README or CAPABILITIES.md where behaviour changed
- [ ] No test writes EEPROM on a real stick
- [ ] Hardware tested (say which model, platform and OS), or not needed
